prompt: Use two relays: button 1 drives relay 1, button 2 drives relay 2, and light 3 comes on if either relay is pulled in.
note: Extras: all four input combinations, each asserting light 3 and both relays (button 1 alone: relay 1 in, relay 2 out; both: both in, light 3 on; button 2 alone: relay 2 in, relay 1 out; neither: both out, light 3 off). The reference asserts only light 3 for the two one-button cases, so light 3 wired straight to + and -, the buttons wired straight to light 3 with no relay, and the relay EITHER-BUT-NOT-BOTH circuit (III-RELAYXOR's wiring) all pass it.
